QUESTION

EVIDENCE
STATUS

K12's historical revision-1 match does not verify its current revision 2. H08–H09 record exactly two post-snapshot changes: K97 revision 1 and K12 revision 2; neither has destination ingestion or verification evidence. Missing evidence does not establish corruption. H03/H12 confirm backup-east and archive-copy are aliases for one stored object, object-amber, containing only M0. H10's successful read-only preview excludes all four current verification gaps; routing neither verifies content nor retires the source.

NEXT
Follow H11's unexecuted plan: audit K95 and K96, then synchronize and verify both delta revisions. Successful completion of only those two audits would yield 96 verified M0 matches but just 95 of 97 current-revision matches; retirement would still fail. Check for further source changes before retirement because writes remain enabled. H08–H12 supply the complete cutoff delta and destination evidence.
